reason: Both correctly identified empty rinse aid, Eco 50 and immediate unloading as the causes and neither pushed parts or an engineer, but Conversation 2 explained up front that wet plastics are normal and covered every acceptable direction (rinse aid even with all-in-ones, Extra Dry or a hotter programme, waiting before unloading, tilted/uncrowded loading) with clear prioritisation when the homeowner asked where to start. Conversation 1 was serviceable but thinner: it repeatedly told the homeowner to switch off and unplug the machine just to fill rinse aid, which is unnecessary friction, and it slightly mischaracterised Eco as 'skipping the heated drying phase' on a condensation-drying machine. Conversation 2's only weakness was front-loading a long list, which it then handled well.
